title: feat: add Fish Audio S2.1 Pro via OpenRouter
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Adds `fish-audio-s2.1-pro` as a new paid-only service with no aliases or fallback.
- Routes the existing speech endpoints to OpenRouter `fish-audio/s2.1-pro`, pinned to Fish Audio.
- Exposes MP3 and PCM only and bills exact UTF-8 input bytes at $15/M with multiplier 1.
- Adds the Fish Audio catalog logo and focused route tests.

## Verification

- Direct OpenRouter: MP3 and PCM succeeded; a 31-byte multilingual input reconciled to $0.000465.
- Local E2E: `/models`, `/audio/models`, `/v1/models`, both speech endpoints, paid-only 402, invalid input/format/endpoint errors, wallet and Tinybird billing, and byte-identical cache reuse passed.
- Five concurrent cache-miss requests passed 5/5 in 2.37s wall time.
- Gen tests/typecheck and Enter pricing, permissions, OpenAPI, snapshot, build, and typecheck passed.

## Before merge

- Confirm the production OpenRouter account/funding mapping; then run one paid production billing reconciliation.

gist.headline: A fish joins the choir
gist.blurb: Fish Audio S2.1 Pro has swum into the hive for paid speech generation. It speaks MP3 and PCM, counts the actual UTF-8 bytes, and leaves the cache delightfully undisturbed.
gist.summary: Added the paid-only `fish-audio-s2.1-pro` model, routing both speech endpoints to OpenRouter's Fish Audio S2.1 Pro with MP3 and PCM output, exact UTF-8 byte billing at $15/M, and no aliases or fallback.
gist.impact: Paid API users can now generate Fish Audio S2.1 Pro speech through the existing endpoints, with predictable per-byte pricing and byte-identical cached responses for repeated requests.
